$comment: syllabi/schema.json. The format of one syllabus version (ROADMAP section 4 7.1; ADR-0013 decision 12): factual topic names, levels, links to the issuing body and the model ids each topic implements. No learning-outcome wording, reading title or exam content: every text field is at most a topic name long, and ids never carry a mark. scripts/web/syllabi.py validates each TOML file against it.
title: A syllabus version mapped to pyeconomics models

format.description: The format of this file; changes only with an incompatible change.

id.description: The syllabus version's neutral id: the file's name without .toml.

title.description: The displayed name, with the issuer's mark as an adjective where it has one.

site.description: The issuing body's site: every link in the file starts with it.

url.description: The issuing body's page for this syllabus version.

checked.description: When the topic names were last read from the issuing body's pages.

topics.description: One entry per level and topic area.

models.description: Per model id, the ids of the topics it implements.

id.description: A neutral slug: lowercase words joined by hyphens, never a mark.

text.description: A name, no longer than a topic name: never a learning outcome or reading title.
